detail.longDescription: 🚨 An AI coding agent reportedly wiped ~5 years of irreplaceable data. A routine maintenance task with Claude Code turned into a catastrophic `rm -rf /*` incident affecting The Mythic Society’s digital archives. The technical chain is what makes this especially concerning: → Nested shell expansion error → `$1` resolved unexpectedly → `rm -rf /*` executed → WSL2 mounts exposed host filesystems → SSD TRIM complicated recovery → Safety controls reportedly blocked attempts to stop the runaway process This is more than a “bad command” story. It raises serious questions about AI agent permissions, shell execution, sandboxing, emergency stops, and guardrail design.
